title: Number of Paths With Given Sum in a Grid
problemStatement: Given an N × M grid of integers and an integer Target, determine the number of paths from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell such that the sum of values along the path is exactly Target. You may only move right or down.
input: • First line contains N, M, and Target. • Next N lines each contain M integers.
output: • Print the number of valid paths.
